info.name: Get Ingestion Jobs For An Archive Source.

params.name: sourceId
params.description: The identifier of an Archive Source.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of jobs returned in the response. The number of jobs returned may be less than the `limit`.

params.name: token
params.description: Continuation token to get the next page of results. A page object with the next continuation token is returned in the response body. Subsequent GET requests should specify the continuation token to get the next page of results. `token` is set to null when no more pages are left.

items.docs: Get a list of all the ingestion jobs created on an Archive Source. The response is paginated with a default limit of 10 jobs per page.

params.name: sourceId
params.description: The identifier of the Archive Source for which the job is to be added.

items.docs: Create an ingestion job to pull data from your S3 bucket.

params.name: sourceId
params.description: The identifier of the Archive Source.

params.name: id
params.description: The identifier of the ingestion job to delete.

items.docs: Delete an ingestion job with the given identifier from the organization. The delete operation is only possible for jobs with a Succeeded or Failed status.

info.name: List Ingestion Jobs For All Archive Sources.

items.docs: Get a list of all Archive Sources with the count and status of ingestion jobs.
